extracted.intended_audience: advanced undergraduate / graduate students and researchers in combinatorics; readers of a combinatorics textbook (Stanley-style)
extracted.subtask_description: Solutions, hints, and commentary for exercises on posets, partitions, generating functions, and related enumerative-combinatorics topics (Young diagrams, rank-selected subposets, Bruhat/weak orders).
